title: US midterm results may give India trade leverage, but tariff and AI risks remain
description: The US midterm results may give India some room in trade negotiations by increasing congressional scrutiny of executive action, but they do not remove tariff risks or alter Washington's strategic priorities. AI investment is also unlikely to retreat, with capital expected to remain within the US rather than shift significantly to emerging markets.

title: IIT Delhi Partners With Walmart Global Tech For Rs 9 Crore AI Research
description: IIT Delhi has collaborated with the Walmart Global Tech to strengthen research, education in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and Data Learning.
